newsitem.title: USA: Banc One's First USA unit Q2 loans rose.
newsitem.headline: Banc One's First USA unit Q2 loans rose.

text.p: Banc One Corp said its First USA unit posted second quarter managed loan growth of about $1.7 billion, or about 30 percent on an annualized basis.
It said it was the strongest non-December quarterly loan growth in the history of the company.
Total managed loans at June 30 were $24.6 billion. The company also opened a record 1.8 million new accounts during the quarter, increasing total cardmembers to 17.8 million.
It said the 30-day delinquency rate on the managed portfolio declined to 4.08 percent at June 30, from 4.62 percent at March 31, 1997.
First USA is a financial services company specializing in the credit card business and is currently the third largest among domestic Visa and MasterCard issuers.
